values.subject: 2025 pre-departure withholding details and one-time bonus treatment
values.body_text:
Payroll and the original withholding receipt show that April 2025 salary income should be CNY 35,600 with CNY 960 tax withheld. The May departure settlement includes May salary and unused-leave compensation, and the first-quarter bonus was reported as a one-time bonus.
The tax application prefilled the April CNY 8,000 performance item and its CNY 800 withholding again, producing CNY 43,600 income and CNY 1,760 tax withheld. This duplicate requires Payroll to verify the original filing receipt.
Please identify the disputed months and matching bank-credit dates by June 18. We will request a correction but will not confirm the annual settlement for you.
